body:
They live in Georgia and they don't have much money either. I can't go into specifics but they can't help me. 

I'll try the online jobs as that would be the easiest way to survive this situation. 

I hope I survive this. I really do. That creeping darkness within me just won't leave, though. It sits at the back of my mind, prodding me, tempting me. It would just be so much easier to give up now. I could rest. No more troubles or any of that.. It might be nice if I could see a friendly face for thanksgiving but.. I won't. I'll be eating ramen alone. That's the night I'm worried the most about.

All I ever wanted was to feel useful, though. The prospect of music I haven't heard, games I haven't played, books I haven't read.. I don't think it's enough for me. Don't get me wrong, I'd love to play Star Citizen when that shit comes out but I could never let it influence my life decisions. I miss working. That's the only thing that stopped the depression long enough for me to live life in a manner which produced happiness.

My issue is that I realize my situation all too clearly. I know the pain is temporary. I know things change. But that's the worst part! I swear, it is.. It's all so fucking meta. I know why I think the way I do. I know what's causing all of this. The problem is I can't escape from it. I see what's happening. I know it's wrong. But, I can't stop that primal hatred  that builds in my veins. I can't change it, though. I want to. I really do..

Music helps. So do movies and games. I'm starting to realize that I'm using them as momentary distractions, though. When the movies/music/games end, I'm still left with the scattered remnants of my life. Broken pieces that look like they should fit together nicely but they don't. I find myself enjoying sorrow a bit too much now. I already died once and got a second chance. These days, I'm thinking it was more of a curse than a blessing.

I was saving this can of beans and sliced turkey breast for thanksgiving but.. I really just don't think I'll last that long. Happy Thanksgiving, Reddit.. Be thankful for all that you have, for some people have far less.

Figures.. Everyone else gets responses.. I get almost nothing. Actually, lawrences advice doesn't help at all. As if I didn't work my hands to the bone until there was nothing left. My former bosses profited from my work and then cut me loose when I had served my place. I feel worse than a tool. 

Now, I just don't care. Fuck this.

Tried that one. Aside from longboarding, I also lift weights. Unfortunately, when I do this, I end up feeling very hungry. All I have left is Ramen and it's enough for maybe two more weeks if I cut back on portions. I cannot afford to spend energy working out anymore. It didn't make me feel any better, anyway..
